name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation menu
description: Site navigation with links and menus that open panels of links.
a11y: A nav landmark with a list of links and menu buttons.
Arrow keys move between top-level items; Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens a panel; Escape closes it.
The current page link has aria-current="page".
usage:
import {NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuTrigger} from '@monoline/react';
